reviews.t: Great product, except doesn't look brand new.
reviews.x: Arrived in just 8 days! I read the reviews and noticed many people received it earlier than expected, and I'm happy that I am also one of those people.  These are strong, difficult to open (the way they should be) and are great for holding hair in place when straightening or styling. I have to give it a four stars instead of five though, because some of the clips are a little scratched, and the plastic is scraping off near the hinges. I expected it to be brand new, but maybe they just got damage

I purchased these clips for the purpose of work. Let me say, I bought them without realizing that I was buying Toni&Guy sectioning clips. The price is excellent for the clips and the amount I get. I love that I can easily open these clips, so it makes my work a bit faster. As well I can easily section hair with them without worrying that it would get tangled in customer's hair. They're excellent for hairdresser or even anyone who needs good clips that can hold either big sections or thick hair.

reviews.t: Also great for dry, brittle, baby-fine, slippery hair!!!
reviews.x: While most of the reviews for these clips are to promote them for thicker hair, I am here to tell all of you who have hair like mine - dry, brittle, slightly kinky, fly-away, baby-fine, slippery - that these work great for our hair, too.  You know what kind of problems we have with clips and bands and what-not either falling out of our hair while trying to use them, or worse, pulling our hair out when we remove them. reviews.t: Why didn't I know about these years ago?!?!?
reviews.x: Great, easy, cheap, lasting well and does the job perfectly.  Plus, they are purple.  Perfection!  I'm not a beauty pro, but I feel somewhat competent armed with these! Clip up for straightening, curling, even just clipping back when no one is looking etc.  Don't leave them in wet hair too long though, unless you want a beautiful kink in there (yup, found that out!)

claims.text: Customers frequently praise the clips for holding hair securely and effectively during styling, coloring, and sectioning.
Many reviewers report fast or early delivery, though a few experienced long shipping times.
Reviewers describe the clips as strong, durable, and well made, with some noting they are intentionally hard to open.
Several customers highlight the good value and generous quantity for the price.
A few reviewers find the clips hard to use or too long, and one had a frustrating cancellation experience.
